edges.reason: T03's seam gate runs the real producer→consumer round-trip against T01's modified consumer to verify S1 conformance to C1 before closure
T03 runs T02's C1/C2 regression suite and cross-checks the new seam tests against it before closure
T04's E2E closure gates E1-E4 and full-suite gate A5 exist to verify T01's consumer fix end-to-end
T04 runs T02's regression file as part of gates E3/E4 (A4/A5 require the 5 wire-contract tests green)
T04's final gates must run after T03 has applied any integration-only seam fixes, so acceptance evidence reflects the integrated state

fake_serialization_removed.why_not_real: A naive 'fix first, then test the fix' reading would order T02 after T01, but T02 writes its tests against the frozen C1/C2 specs (and DA-1) and owns a disjoint path; it consumes no output, file, or path of T01 — the shared context is exactly the frozen contracts, which is what unlocks their parallel execution

The reverse order ('test first') is equally unjustified: T01 does not consume T02's test file — it needs only C1/C2/DA-1 and the consumer module; no contract/data/ownership/verification reason exists in either direction
Not removed — kept as a real verification edge: T04's gates exist to verify T01's output (unlike the T01/T02 pair, there is no frozen-spec substitute for running the actual fix through the e2e gates)

collisions_handled: none — T01 owns pipeline/consumer.py; T02 owns tests/test_wire_contract.py; T03 owns tests/integration/ + docs/wire-contract-consistency.md; T04 owns tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py; no prefix overlap between any pair of owned paths
free_parallelism_trades: T01 ∥ T02 parallelism is bought by freezing C1/C2/DA-1 in stage 1; consequence: T02's consumer-resolution test is red until T01 lands (expected TDD state, recorded in T02's package and checkpoint, closed by T04's A4/A5 gates) — an accepted trade, not a hidden dependency

T03 and T04 are serialized (T03 before T04) because T04's evidence must reflect the integrated state after any integration-only fixes; merging them would hide which fix made the gates green and kill local recoverability
